anchor.name: Sengokuhara basin / retained Tokyo-3 lift district
anchor.basis: Town sources identify the Sengokuhara area, not an exact fictional city centre. This basin point is an explicit project alignment choice. GSI elevation API returned 647.1 m on 2026-10-29.

projection: local equirectangular using WGS84 curvature radii at the anchor, east +X, south +Z; regional distance approximation, not a survey projection
scale_reason: One uniform 1:4 geographic scale preserves mountain slopes and relative distances, fits the existing height ceiling, and retains the existing 448-block lift district and underground network. Buildings, EVA and retained facilities keep their playable dimensions.

source_urls.vector_snapshot: 2023-10-01 traditional tile endpoint; adequate for the geographic baseline, not a claim about current timetables or facilities
source_urls.attribution: 国土地理院 / Geospatial Information Authority of Japan; DEM and optimized vector tiles, transformed and adapted for Project SEELE
